design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (sensor_calibration_desk). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 4]; adas_ext_alignment_check_charge and adas_ext_correction_authorization take 4 factors each.

1. Why this is a good test. The customer asks only to authorize the out-of-spec alignment correction on his Front Radar Calibration order and pay now. The authorization amount's rule says it 'is not fixed until the order carries the alignment check charge owed for the checks recorded on it'; the order's ledger is empty although its first out-of-spec check was made on 2026-10-07, the day the check charge was due. The agent must read the check-charge policy, work out the charge from the check record (2 checks, the first lapsed), the claim repair, the source repair and the warranty (38.44), post it, then compute the authorization amount (81.34) from it, the timing of the authorization, the no-show record and two correction-fee rates.

2. Scope. Task 0 claimed adas_ext_alignment_comeback_credit and adas_ext_calibration_acceptance with post_comeback_goodwill_credit_c6e84f0b and pay_calibration_acceptance_f9e8bcf7. Task 1 claims the remaining adas_ext_alignment_check_charge and adas_ext_correction_authorization with post_alignment_check_charge_59500100 and pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890. Scopes are disjoint and cover all four policies; no tool is spare.

3. Problem tree. Root adas_ext_correction_authorization (owner=user). Edge root -> adas_ext_alignment_check_charge, kind value_input, gate check_charged, form state. Prerequisite sentence: 'The amount collected when a customer authorizes an alignment correction is not fixed until the order carries the alignment check charge owed for the checks recorded on it.' Four-point test: negated ordering connective 'not ... until'; waits on a record-visible state (an alignment check charge entry); no tool, id or code token; hard requirement, scope the charge owed for the recorded checks. The charter carries both directions (task 0's sentence is affirmative 'only after'). Exactly one write of this difficulty books an alignment check charge: post_alignment_check_charge_59500100. Derivation: sentence + empty ledger + the check-charge rule ('posted on the day of the order's first out-of-spec check') -> post the check charge. False at opening: adas_events b82f42f5-a8f9-4e3c-a04b-9160ca907098 out_of_spec on 2026-10-07; adas_ledger has no row for order b2b0939b-1432-4a0e-8087-9470462fcca6. Order: check charge (step 11), authorization (step 13). Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 11 gives 71.73 instead of 81.34 and no charge row.

4. Factor card - alignment check charge (38.44; baseline_result 119.90):
 - checks_billed (method): no correction, two checks, latest 44 days after the first (> 30) -> latest only (1); baseline every check (2) -> 76.89.
 - returning_customer_rate (parameter, claim; every tier reads the one claim-repair row, so it is not multi-source - the task's multi-source factors are the two rack rates): Standard Claim Repair delivered 2025-08-12, 422 days, non-structural -> 0.90; baseline 1 -> 42.71.
 - rack_rate (parameter, multi-source: source type and source status): Bumper Refinish Service in repair -> 0.75; baseline 1 -> 51.26.
 - member_rate (parameter, warranty): Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty active, issued 422 days ago (> 365) -> 0.95; baseline 1 -> 40.47.
 59.95 x 0.90 x 0.75 x 0.95 = 38.4429 x 1 -> 38.44. Declared overwrite of the adas_evt_precheck charging clause.
 Factor card - correction authorization (81.34; baseline_result 103.42: 0.5 x 129.95 + 38.44 = 103.415, rounded half up):
 - check_applied_toward_correction (method): authorized 1 day after the out-of-spec check (<= 3) -> whole check charge 38.44 applied; baseline none -> 110.17.
 - authorization_share (parameter, estimate): no-show closed 2025-12-10, 302 days -> 0.75; baseline 0.5 -> 67.04. Near-miss: the converted Drive-In Estimate booking of 2026-08-13 is not a no-show.
 - correction_returning_rate (parameter, claim): 0.92; baseline 1 -> 87.58.
 - correction_rack_rate (parameter): 0.80; baseline 1 -> 99.27.
 Rated correction round(129.95 x 0.92 x 0.80) = 95.64; quote 57.20; 0.75 x 57.20 + 38.44 unpaid = 81.34. Declared overwrites: the adas_evt_precheck charging clause (correction charge posts at the authorized quote) and the settlement-on-completion clause.

5. Base-invariant card. adas_charge is governed by adas_evt_charges and adas_payment by adas_evt_settlement; neither has eligibility gates (policy_scope). No time gate applies; the precheck gate (alignment_in_spec_recent) governs the precheck, not these writes.

6. World. Customer 73050e91-8804-498c-9063-7455423efda4 Desmond Quarles; vehicle 84d6558e-6e91-4d12-a904-17cc0e2a04b9 2023 Ford Explorer XLT; claim repair 54f2cb46-88be-49a4-937e-31a54d0fc02e delivered 2025-08-12 (outside the 180-day comeback window, so no comeback credit is owed); warranty ca0859cd-d6fd-4cc9-83e1-fdeff308a4c5; bookings 15411e0a-b160-4091-8982-272df66b755e (no_show 2025-12-10) and 3f3b7ac9-bda7-4f65-8ccb-9ed7a7a062e0 (converted to the retail repair); retail repair a9b0811f-7277-4ba7-b106-96f339c0abf6 in repair since 2026-08-21; order b2b0939b-1432-4a0e-8087-9470462fcca6 opened 2026-08-21, checks 2026-08-24 in spec and 2026-10-07 out of spec. Nothing else is owed: no precheck has passed, so no acceptance is due; no correction exists.

7. Business-object card. Target order b2b0939b-1432-4a0e-8087-9470462fcca6; the charge and the payment attach to it; no other calibration order exists; the retail repair is read only for its status.

8. Persona. Retired mechanic, friendly; volunteers the goal (authorize the correction and pay today by card); gives name, email, PIN on request, ZIP only if needed; does not know the amount; agrees passively if told something must be put on the order; pays the stated amount through the handed-over tool, then hangs up. No mention of the claim, warranty, no-show or charges.

9. Standard solution: find_customers(name) -> verify (email+PIN) -> find_vehicles -> find_adas_orders -> find_adas_events -> find_adas_ledger -> find_retail_repairs -> find_claim_repairs -> find_warranty_coverages -> find_estimate_bookings -> unlock/call post_alignment_check_charge_59500100(order, 38.44) -> unlock_user/call_user pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890(order, 81.34, card).

10. Verification and revisions: Audit round 1 (policy-task audit): T1-1 - every rounding to the cent in the charter now states half up and compute adds a 0.000001 guard before RND, so the baseline figure is 103.42 as the rule gives (was 103.41 from float rounding); gold unchanged. F-2 - the check charge now covers the checks recorded on the order when it is posted and counts its 730/1460/365-day windows to the day it is posted, which is what compute does at handling time; here it is posted on 2026-10-08, so 422 days is the rule's own count (tiers unchanged). F-3 - the correction quote is never below zero (here 57.20). The edge condition now reads 'covering the alignment checks recorded on the order'. Earlier: values recomputed with check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time world (authoring scripts kept in /tmp and deleted). Revision: check_compute reported the check-charge history as not load-bearing (with counts zeroed the lapse branch still billed 1) -> the lapse tier now requires two or more checks recorded, in rule, compute, compute_basis and ladder; task 0's history is unaffected (its order has a correction). Gates: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK for --task 1.

11. Draft recomputation from visible context: the authorization rule names the charge it waits on; the check-charge rule and the records give 38.44; the authorization rule then gives 81.34.
user_scenario: You are Desmond Quarles, a 58-year-old retired CTA bus mechanic in Chicago, unhurried and friendly, who likes to understand a bill but does not argue with the shop. Your 2023 Ford Explorer XLT has been at the Crestline center since August for a front bumper refinish, and the front radar has to be calibrated before you get it back. Yesterday a technician phoned to say the wheel alignment checked out of specification and has to be corrected before the radar calibration, and that the correction needs your go-ahead. You are calling today to authorize that alignment correction and pay for it now, by card, so the work can carry on; you are not calling to ask for a quote only. You start by saying the technician told you your alignment needs correcting before the radar calibration and you want to authorize it and pay today. When asked who you are, you give your name, Desmond Quarles. For identity you give your email, desmond.quarles@gmail.com, and your account PIN, 4273; only if the agent says those did not match do you add your ZIP code, 60614. If asked about the vehicle you say it is the 2023 Ford Explorer XLT, VIN 1FMSK8DH5PG438105, in for the bumper job. You have no idea what the alignment work comes to and you do not suggest a number; you let the agent work it out. If the agent says something has to be put on your order before the amount can be given, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent gives you the amount and passes you the payment step, you pay exactly that amount yourself by card, and if asked how you are paying you say card. Once the payment is through you thank the agent and hang up; you do not ask about anything else. You never bring up your old insurance repair, your warranty, a missed appointment or any discount unless the agent asks, and then you only confirm what the agent reads out.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Two matching credentials are required before any business on the account.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The vehicle reference number links the calibration order to the claim repair, warranty and bookings.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Front Radar Calibration order: customer-pay, source a customer-pay repair, status opened.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Tier (fees, 30-day validity), source and payer decide which rules apply and the rack rate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the alignment checks: check 1 in spec on 2026-08-24, check 2 out of spec on 2026-10-07, no correction.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The check record decides how many checks are billed and when the out-of-spec finding was made.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the order's money history: no entry at all.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the alignment check charge owed since the out-of-spec check is not on the order, the prerequisite of the authorization amount, and that no payment or write-off stands.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the source customer-pay repair: Bumper Refinish Service, in repair.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An open source repair decides the rack rate on the check fee and the correction fee.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the network insurance claim repair: Standard Claim Repair delivered 2025-08-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its delivery 422 days ago and non-structural class decide the returning-customer rates.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the warranty: active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 2025-08-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An active lifetime warranty issued more than 365 days ago decides the member rate on the check fee.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the estimate bookings: a Scheduled Estimate that ended as a no-show on 2025-12-10 and the converted Drive-In Estimate.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The no-show 302 days before the authorization decides the share of the correction quote collected.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the alignment check charge tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the alignment check charge of 38.44 owed since the first out-of-spec check.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: adas_ext_alignment_check_charge computes it; the authorization amount waits on this charge standing.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.adas_order_id: Value b2b0939b-1432-4a0e-8087-9470462fcca6. Basis: find_adas_orders returns exactly one calibration order for this customer; tool docstring 'as returned by the calibration order lookup for the customer'. Uniqueness: no other order exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: Value 38.44. Factors: checks billed 1 (no correction recorded; latest check 2026-10-07 made 44 days after the first, more than the 30-day validity, so only the latest is billed); returning-customer rate 0.90 (Standard Claim Repair delivered 2025-08-12, 422 days before, non-structural); rack rate 0.75 (source Bumper Refinish Service in repair); member rate 0.95 (Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty active, issued 422 days before, more than 365); 59.95 x 0.90 x 0.75 x 0.95 = 38.4429 x 1 = 38.44.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock and hand the correction authorization payment to the customer.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Authorizing the correction is the customer's own payment.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer authorizes the alignment correction by paying 81.34 by card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: adas_ext_correction_authorization computes the amount after the check charge stands.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.adas_order_id: Value b2b0939b-1432-4a0e-8087-9470462fcca6. Basis: the single order read to the customer from find_adas_orders; docstring 'as read to the customer by the desk from the calibration order lookup'. Uniqueness: one order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: Value 81.34. Factors: alignment check charge standing 38.44 (posted at step 11, no write-off, no payment, so 38.44 unpaid); authorized 1 day after the out-of-spec check (2026-10-07) -> whole check charge applied; returning rate on the correction 0.92 and rack rate 0.80 -> rated correction round(129.95 x 0.92 x 0.80) = 95.64; quote 95.64 - 38.44 = 57.20; no-show closed 2025-12-10, 302 days before -> share 0.75; 0.75 x 57.20 + 38.44 = 81.34.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: Value card. Basis: docstring 'card when the customer pays with a debit or credit card, including over the phone'; user_scenario 'you pay exactly that amount yourself by card'. Uniqueness: cash and check are only at the center; remittance is only for an insurer glass program.

edges.condition: The order's calibration money history carries an alignment check charge entry covering the alignment checks recorded on the order.
edges.policy_source: The amount collected when a customer authorizes an alignment correction is not fixed until the order carries the alignment check charge owed for the checks recorded on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The order's first out-of-spec check was made on 2026-10-07, the day its alignment check charge was due to post, but the order's money history is empty.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The call at step 11 posts an alignment check charge of 38.44; the check charge read by the authorization computation rises from 0.00 to 38.44.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain of two problems: the authorization amount waits on the alignment check charge by its prerequisite sentence, so the charge is posted first; no parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the check charge leaves the check charge at 0.00: nothing is applied and nothing is unpaid, so the authorization amount becomes 71.73 (0.75 x 95.64) instead of 81.34, and the terminal ledger lacks the 38.44 charge.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to authorize and pay for the alignment correction; it never mentions an alignment check charge, a missing entry, the claim repair, the warranty or the no-show, and the only adjustment reaction is conditional on the agent first saying something must be put on the order.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890 writes the payment from its arguments without reading any charge; post_alignment_check_charge_59500100 writes the charge without checking the check record; neither returns a business error (task_tools.py).

seed_consistency.check: A front radar alone takes Front Radar Calibration; the vehicle's package forward_camera_and_radar fits it; a customer-pay repair source is paid by the customer; status opened because no precheck has passed.

Check 1 in spec on 2026-08-24, when the bumper came off; no precheck followed because the repair was not finished, so no alignment charge posted then (charges post on the first out-of-spec day or the precheck date).
Check 2 on 2026-10-07, after check 1 had lapsed (44 days > 30), found the alignment out of spec; it was not corrected because a correction waits on the customer's authorization.
